behavior: The page opens with what Gen9 is and for whom, its goals and limits, what's outside it, how it's built and why, the cast, and how to read it
A deeper step traces what a person is told before signing up: the sign-up page's data notice, the privacy page, the AI notice under the composer
A deeper step traces search: the page's four modes, a run's rows in chat_search, words by BM25, meaning by pgvector, titles by pg_trgm
A deeper step traces a long chat summarized: context.summarized, the note, the whole chat kept
A deeper step traces a helper (the fact checker) the agent delegates to
A deeper step traces a provider failing: the run waits for Retry, then continues
A deeper step traces a person's model limit: Model use in Settings, the refusal with its reset date
A deeper step traces a file attached to a message: stored in Postgres, seen in the environment
A deeper step traces a task with Done when: graded against its rubric, retried until met
A deeper step traces a task's email when it's done
A deeper step traces a background task: its own chat, told back to the chat that started it
Deeper steps trace a connector that signs in (OAuth), one whose tools change, one with an app, one that asks, and the directory
Deeper steps trace an environment's life (its workflow), its secrets and egress, and its disk
A deeper step traces a plugin that changed waiting for an admin's review
A deeper step traces an admin role granted and removed, applying at once, and the audit log page
Deeper steps trace an agent that registers itself and what an A2A agent reaches, and MCP's tools
A deeper step traces a person's data export before deletion
Deeper steps trace Temporal's, the router's, Postgres's, Langfuse's and the sandbox server's insides
A deeper step traces what Gen9 does when things fail: limits, NUL, the database refusing writes
A deeper step traces the operator's toolbox: doctor, updates, audit, stopping every agent, resealing, key rotation, logs, disk
The reference names every service, workflow, Schedule, API operation, table and make command of the running system
A full run of the verifier, deeper batches included, passes, and the page check passes

An admin who signs in with a password and has no second step sets up an authenticator app before the sign-in ends; one with an app is asked for its code; a passkey admin and a member are asked nothing more; Temporal UI's sign-in asks the same
Made admin in Gen9 while signed in, someone with no second step is signed out, and their next sign-in sets one up
Every check that signs the seeded admin in answers the second step: make e2e as one command and gen9-learn's full run pass
